title: A Multi-Agent LLM System for Automated Tuning of Specialized Neural Network Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.13663v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many machine learning approaches are two-level: an expert selects a class of methods, within this class the choice of key components is critical and usually manual. This paper addresses the automatic tuning of these components and proposes a framework transferable across models of different nature. The multi-agent large language model (LLM) framework has three roles---analyst, coder, and recorder~---with an experiment log and a sandboxed execution environment. Unlike systems that optimize the entire ML script or search architectures in a discrete space, the framework operates over an open but semantically narrow space: the agent generates code only for the specified components, leaving the overall network structure unchanged. The approach is validated in two directions: tuning a classification spiking neural network with correlation learning, and solving high-order differential equations with Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINN). translated_title: 用于专用神经网络模型自动调优的多智能体LLM系统
translated_abstract: 许多机器学习方法都是两级结构：专家先选定一类方法，而在该类方法内部，关键组件的选择至关重要且通常依赖人工。本文致力于实现这些组件的自动调优，并提出了一种可跨不同性质模型迁移的框架。该多智能体大语言模型（LLM）框架包含三个角色——分析师、编码员和记录员——并配备实验日志和沙盒执行环境。与优化整个机器学习脚本或在离散空间中搜索架构的系统不同，该框架在一个开放但语义上狭窄的空间中运作：智能体仅为指定的组件生成代码，而保持整体网络结构不变。该方法在两个方向上得到验证：调优基于相关性学习的分类脉冲神经网络，以及使用物理信息神经网络（PINN）求解高阶微分方程。
tldr: 本文提出一个由分析师、编码员和记录员组成的多智能体LLM框架，在保持整体网络结构不变的前提下自动生成并调优指定关键组件的代码，并可迁移至脉冲神经网络分类与PINN求解高阶微分方程等不同类型模型。
en_tdlr: A multi-agent LLM framework with analyst, coder, and recorder roles automatically tunes key neural network components by generating code only for specified parts while preserving the overall architecture, validated on spiking neural networks and PINNs.
